$comment: What each desktop release changed, written for the person deciding whether to press Update — not a changelog. The release workflow reads the entry matching apps/desktop/package.json version and publishes it in latest.json, which is what the update window renders. Keep every line in plain words: no selector names, no hook names, no file paths. If a line would not mean anything to a student in a pit, it does not belong here.

0.1.0.headline: Predictions now work at off-season events, and the app updates itself.
added: Match scores are estimated from your own scouting when no official numbers exist — off-season events like GRITS, week-0 scrimmages, and the first morning of an event
A robot your scouts keep seeing break down is marked down automatically, which the official ratings cannot see
The app tells you when a new version is ready and what changed, instead of going quiet
Mac builds update themselves the same way Windows ones do
fixed: The team calendar opened on a week grid you had to drag sideways to read on a phone
The scouting form's first field sat below the bottom of a phone screen, so a scout saw no form at all
Pages showed your team's name twice, as "Team 6925 (Team 6925)"
The browser tab said Vantage twice on several pages
next: Pit scouting feeding the same score estimates
A colour scheme that reads as calmer and less blue
